about: Table 1 of arXiv:2510.11710 (Phys. Rev. B 113, 245104), arXiv HTML parsed locally: six ansatze at U/t = 8, hole doping 1/8, with E_0/M and sigma^2/M as printed. The 8x8 torus rows map to Hubbard/square_64_P_28_8 (64 sites, 28 electrons per spin, periodic); the 8x4 rows are cylinders and map to Hubbard/rectangular-4x8_32_PO_14_8. Energy per site x N; variance per site x N. Row notes cite this file by its earlier form, scripts/add_sweep3_rows.mjs (git history).
